reviews.name: Jeniffer Miranda
reviews.text:
I don’t say this lightly - my Surf Yoga Beer trip to the Philippines was unlike anything I’ve ever experienced!  That’s saying a lot, even compared to other SYB trips I’ve been on.
Palawan is truly a hidden gem, it’s one of those places you don’t even realize is missing from your bucket list until you’re there, completely in awe.  The experience with TAO, and the incredible TAO boys, made it even more special.  They took care of everything from navigating the boat expedition to setting up our beach huts to sleep in each night and of course keeping us well fed with delicious, freshly made meals (and plenty of jungle juice).  Their local knowledge, high energy, and ability to create fun out of every moment took the whole adventure to another level.
What really made this trip unforgettable though were our leaders, Lizzie and Ryan.  You could feel how much intention they put into curating an experience that fostered genuine connection.  The nature of the trip already sets the stage with no cell service, no distractions, stripped down from the “real world” (goodbye makeup and hot showers), and instead you’re placed on remote, breathtaking beaches surrounded by incredible people.  Yet somehow Lizzie and Ryan elevated it even more.  Their excitement for leading workouts, sunset yoga, mindful moments, and themed parties was contagious.  They created a space where everyone felt comfortable being their most authentic selves, something that seems rare these days.  Also, a special shoutout to Ryan for capturing everyone’s best moments through candid photos, I’m talking frame-worthy memories from the trip of a lifetime.
This may not be SYB’s most well-known trip but honestly, it should be!  It perfectly balances movement, adventure, and meaningful social connection in a setting that feels almost unreal.  You leave not just with memories, but with a true sense of belonging, to nature, to the people you met, and to the SYB community as a whole.
If you weren’t considering this trip before, I hope you are now… and if you need one more reason here it is: Lizzie is leading this trip again in 2027!  Don’t miss it.

reviews.name: Brayden Scott
reviews.text:
SYB Philippines - Incredible setup and Philippines is a very picturesque location, the Palawan islands are a bit of a hidden gem.

The 6 day boat tour with the Tao foundation and the lost boys is the best one I’ve been on, food freshly cooked along the way, freshly made bed each night, sleeping in a hut each night next to the beach, snorkel stops along the way and even some beach volleyball, the lost boys are there with you for everything making sure everyone is safe and having as much fun as possible.

Leaders- Ryan and Lizzie were part of the group but made sure every single person was involved along the way. Lizzie’s workouts and yoga sessions made me enjoy group workouts which I didn’t think was possible. Ryan’s photos and videos were awesome and all photos ready by end of trip. He captured the whole experience but was involved all the way through. A couple of great leaders and would make me look at booking the same trip again if they were leaders.

reviews.name: Sara Balaban
reviews.text:
I just got back from SYB's Palawan, Philippines Island-hopping adventure, and out of the 7 SYB trips I've taken so far, this one just snagged my number 1 spot. The Philippines with SYB feels like a secret people desperately need to know about. First off, leaders Lizzie and Ryan were phenomenal, and the smaller group allowed for deep connections and community, something we are all craving. Even better? No cell service for 5 days, was the gift I had been yearning for. I was able to be present and appreciate the beautiful surroundings and real-time conversations with really awesome people. Sleeping in beach huts was an amazing experience, and considering we were sleeping mostly on private island with just our group, the bathroom situation was totally fine. (coming from a girl living in the upper east side of NYC).  Honestly, it was so freeing not worrying about what I was wearing or how my hair looked, because we were living in swim suits and in the ocean all day snorkeling, kayaking, or getting sandy during yoga and beach workouts. This trip is the epitome of a 'primal reset," - everything that SurfYogaBeer stands for: community, wellness, connection, mindfulness. If you need a digital detox, love boat days, the ocean, the freshest organic food, beach games, dancing under the stars, and want to experience the best trip of your life....SurfYogaBeer Philippines is a MUST!

PS: we had a jack russell puppy on our boat for the week, which was a HUGE added bonus.

reviews.name: Cole Untiedt
reviews.text: Surf Yoga Beer is the best group travel out there! Everything is handled and communicated to you ahead of time, and you are introduced to the group. My trip with them to the Philippines was a complete delight, and it was certainly an elevated experience which I could not have experienced with any other group or company. All there leaders are accomplished, and make the trip an experience you will want to come back for! 🏄🏽‍♂️

reviews.name: Lisette B
reviews.text: Having been on at least one trip a year over the past 5 years, I cannot be more grateful for SYB and to be part of the SYB family. Not only have I been to places I would have never been myself such as deserted islands in the Philippines or the mountains of Ireland, the sense of adventure and friendship on those trips unmatched! A week with SYB feels like a month on any other holiday, because they make sure you’ll be doing all the things. I made lifelong friends and every trip is more special than the last. Doing things out of your comfort zone is great for lifelong bonding with your new friends and feeling on top of the world after every trip. A special shoutout to all the leaders who bring all the energy to make sure you have the trip of lifetime. DON’T THINK JUST DO and book that trip!!!!

reviews.name: Savanna Cyr
reviews.text:
My trip to the Philippines with Surf Yoga Beer (SYB) stole my heart. It was my first solo trip and my first time to Asia. This company made me feel safe and welcome. The SYB staff encourages you to be yourself and live for adventure without fear. I enjoyed the connections I made, and the people I met became my friends. I do talk to most after the trip. For someone looking to step outside of their comfort zone, explore a new place, and connect with others and yourself, I encourage you to book a trip with Surf Yoga Beer. I've already done it!

Booking a trip with SYB was easy and accessible. The accommodations promised on the SYB website were presented, and all expectations outmatched reality. There is no travel stress on this trip; SYB takes care of you.

reviews.name: Kirsty Cowie
reviews.text:
My journey with SurfYogaBeer (SYB) started in 2019 when I joined a trip to the Philippines. I had just quit my job and I was supposed to go Bali with a friend, but at the last minute she pulled out. I now needed a Plan B.

I spoke with one of my friends who recommended SYB and a few days later I was flying solo to the Philippines. Mantas (the founder) would say this was a Don't Think Just Do Moment!!

Before my trip to the Philippines I had never travelled alone before. I was confident that I would have a good time, but what I couldn't have foreseen where the friends I would make. The group was small (approx. 25 people) and I met one of my best friends there. We have since travelled together to several different countries including NICARAGUA!!

I write NICARAGUA in all caps, because I loved this SYB destination so much - I ended up moving there for 2.5 years after the trip (lol). SYB literally changed my life. I learnt to surf, which is now one of my biggest passions, lived in a surf community and met some pretty extraordinary people.

The leaders at SYB, especially the founders and leaders Mantas & Steph, work hard to make sure that these trips aren't only a good time for a week but that you make connections that will stay with you a very long time (hopefully a life time). Thank you guys x10000 for starting company. Can't wait to see more of the world with you.

reviews.name: Lizzie Allcock
reviews.text:
This is unlike any travel company I’ve ever been with. Surf Yoga Beer gives you such an incredible opportunity to see the most amazing places in the world surrounded by likeminded travelers. I went on my trip not knowing anyone but left with lifetime friends. If you are a solo traveler looking for a travel group (usually ages 25+) that is adventurous, mindful, social, loving and supportive, look no further, this is the company for you.

The Palawan trip is AMAZING. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Blair Herman
reviews.text: THE MOST INCREDIBLE EXPERIENCE I HAVE EVER HAD! If you’re thinking about booking a trip just do it. I met the most amazing group of people and got to be a part of a truly unique itinerary. I went to the Philippines and it’s just so beautiful you feel like you’re inside a photograph. Not to mention the workouts were fantastic huge highlight for me. I honestly cried when we got to Coron and had to leave the boat because I didn’t want to the trip to end. Mahal kita SYB

reviews.name: Brian Schulz
reviews.text: Sailed around The Philippines' Palawan Islands for a week making pit stops to recharge, refuel + reinvigorate the mind, body + soul. We may have lost track of the days in our remote week skimming the far limits of the South China Sea but what we did find was a connection, an enthusiasm + a zest for the unknown that only Surf Yoga Beer can uniquely deliver with new + old friends.
